notes: VolatilityGuard Lab is one standalone Sepolia contract job with no website or IPFS deliverable. VolatilityGuardHook is constructed with the immutable Sepolia PoolManager 0xe03a1074c86cfedd5c142c4f04f1a1536e203543; VolatilityGuardToken has no constructor arguments. The hook declares only afterInitialize, beforeSwap and afterSwap (address bits 4288 / 0x10c0); every return-delta, liquidity and donation permission is false. Callbacks authenticate PoolManager and never use sender or hookData as identity. There is no discretionary admin, custody or fee override. Guards are isolated by full PoolId, using a bounded 16-observation tick TWAP, absolute-tick-movement EWMA, adaptive deviation limits and a shared per-pool leaky volume bucket charged from realized deltas with upward rounding. Both directions and exact-input/output swaps are supported, subject to core settlement, price, liquidity and volume limits. NORMAL/WARMUP/GUARDED/RECOVERY transitions include stale-history reset and deterministic timed recovery. Rejected swaps roll back transitions; permissionless checkpoint can persist observed health. LP additions and exits have no hook gate, and initialization/warmup remains usable. Arbitrary currencies are supported within core accounting assumptions. Internal oracle manipulation, budget griefing, JIT liquidity and MEV within limits remain possible; this is not total MEV protection. The target pool is native ETH (zero address) paired with VGL, static fee 3000 and tick spacing 60. For final token T and mined hook H, its PoolKey is (address(0), T, uint24(3000), int24(60), H); PoolId is keccak256 of those five ABI-encoded words, not packed encoding. Initial sqrtPriceX96 is 792281625142643375935439503360000 (10000 * 2^96), representing 0.00000001 ETH/VGL at 18 decimals. Token-only bootstrap uses the widest aligned range below the opening price and exact integer liquidity math. Buy VGL with ETH first; reverse swaps require accrued ETH liquidity. Use existing verified periphery; test helpers are not deployment artifacts. Source includes tests, implementation-derived ABIs and architecture/integration documentation. Independent review, publication, signed artifact linkage, admission, verification and deployment are later service steps; this manifest claims none completed. Deployment policy is separately versioned and is not set by these notes.
